mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic (circle_id, user_id, title, content, create_time) VALUES (#{circleId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE topic SET reply_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM topic t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT t.*, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM topic t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
